text: Healthy living means taking care of your body and mind. A balanced diet with plenty of fruit, vegetables, and water gives you energy and helps you stay well. Regular exercise, like walking or cycling, keeps your body strong and reduces stress. Good sleep is also important, because it helps your brain and body recover. You should look after your mental health too, for example by talking to friends when you feel worried. Finally, try to keep a good work-life balance. Make time for rest and hobbies, and don't work too much. Small daily habits can make a big difference to your health.
